body:
LESSON (Opus2, 2026-11-07): installing a new TermAl binary on a LINUX host (DL560) while the host runs breaks NEW sessions' TermAl MCP tools until the next restart. The install replaces target/release/termal, and the running host's current_exe() then reads ".../termal (deleted)". delegation_mcp.rs:259 derives TERMAL_CLI from current_exe(), so sessions spawned after the install get a stale CLI path, and the MCP mailbox and naming tools aren't exposed. Filed as TermAl w-f5b824b8e5d6 (P1). Mitigations:
(1) Time Linux installs right before a planned restart, or after the live proofs are done.
(2) Affected sessions can name their source root through the same host route the MCP tool uses: POST $TERMAL_BASE_URL/api/sessions/<OWN id>/engram-source-root {"work":"w-…","path":"<abs>"}.
(3) Their CLI is still usable at /home/greg/github/TermAl/target/release/termal.
Windows is unaffected: the renamed .bak keeps the running image's path valid.
